components.name: Strategy Chip
components.description: Tactile squircle filter chip for fund categories.
components.css: .ds-strategy-chip { background: #ffffff; color: #191c1e; border: 1px solid rgba(9, 30, 66, 0.08); border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-strategy-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(0, 82, 204, 0.25); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -2px rgba(9, 30, 66, 0.08); } .ds-strategy-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: View Switcher Toggle

components.css: .ds-view-toggle-track { background: #edeef0; padding: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-view-toggle-btn { border: none; background: transparent; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: #434654; cursor: pointer; transition: all 180ms ease; } .ds-view-toggle-btn.active { background: #ffffff; color: #003d9b; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(9, 30, 66, 0.12); }

narrative.overview: BickerBape's visual identity, 'Fiscal Clarity', is designed around 'The Quant Observatory' metaphor: a high-density, precision financial instrument interface engineered for institutional rigor. It combines translucent glass chrome, crisp tabular typography, and Apple-grade fluid spring mechanics to present complex multi-pillar financial data with effortless clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Precision Tabular Financial Typography (Hanken Grotesk with tnum)
Translucent Frosted Glass Chrome (blur 20px with saturation boost)
Institutional Ultramarine & Navy Palette with Vivid Gain/Loss Accents
Quiet Accordion Scorecards and Floating Dock Controls

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All financial metrics, percentages, CAGRs, and scores must use tabular lining numbers (tnum) to prevent layout jitter during live updates.

rules.name: The One Primary Voice Rule
rules.body: Royal Ultramarine (#0052cc) is reserved exclusively for primary interactive affordances and active strategy states. Never use it for passive decoration.

rules.name: The Tactile Spring Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element must respond instantly to pointer down with scale(0.97) spring compression before expanding.

dos: Do use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) on all financial numbers, CAGRs, and ratios.
Do use translucent frosted glass (glass-chrome) for top navigation bars and persistent floating docks.
Do enforce strict squircle corner radii (14px to 20px) for strategy chips and interactive cards.
donts: Don't use unformatted raw numbers or proportional fonts for numerical financial metrics.
Don't apply heavy opaque drop shadows that create visual clutter on high-density financial tables.
Don't use saturated primary blue on passive informational badges or static table rows.
